name: Form
usage: Create and edit dialogs, settings pages, sign-in

props.name: form
props.description: The form instance from `Form.useForm()`, to read and write the form from outside.

props.name: layout
props.description:
Layout of the fields: `vertical` (label above the field, the usual choice), `horizontal` (label on the left)
or `inline` (fields in one row, such as a filter bar).

props.name: initialValues
props.description: Initial values of the fields.

props.name: onFinish
props.description: Called with the values when the form is submitted and every field is valid.

props.name: onFinishFailed
props.description: Called when the form is submitted but some fields are invalid.

props.name: onValuesChange
props.description: Called when the user changes a value, with the changed values and all values.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables all fields.

props.name: requiredMark
props.description:
Marks required fields: `true` (the default), `false` for no mark, or `optional` to mark the optional fields
instead.

props.name: validateTrigger
props.description:
When fields are validated, for example `onChange`. By default a field is validated on blur, and on every change
once it has shown an error.

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the form; it prefixes the ids of the fields.

props.name: children
props.description: Contents of the form: Form.Item fields, the submit button and so on.

props.name: ref
props.description: The native `<form>` element.

members.name: Form.Item
members.summary:
One field of a Form: the label, the control, the validation rules and the error or hint below the control. With
`name`, it binds its only child (a control such as Input or Select) to that field of the form values: the child
receives `value` (or the prop named by `valuePropName`, such as `checked`) and `onChange`, so do not set `value`
yourself (an `onChange` of your own is still called). Without `name`, it only lays out a label around its
children, such as a row of buttons.

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the field in the form values. Without it, the item is only a label and a layout around its children.

props.name: label
props.description: Label of the field.

props.name: rules
props.description: Validation rules.

props.name: required
props.description: Shows the required mark. Use `rules` with `required` to actually check it.

props.name: help
props.description: Hint below the field; replaced by the error while there is one.

props.name: extra
props.description: Additional text below the field, shown together with errors.

props.name: initialValue
props.description: Initial value of this field.

props.name: valuePropName
props.description: Name of the prop of the control that holds the value, such as `checked` for Checkbox and Switch.

props.name: status
props.description: Shows a status without a rule, for checks done elsewhere (such as on the server).

props.name: validateTrigger
props.description: When this field is validated; see the `validateTrigger` of Form.

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hides the field but keeps its value in the form.

props.name: children
props.description: The control, such as an Input. With `name`, it receives `value` and `onChange` from the form.

members.name: Form.useForm
members.summary:
Hook that creates a form instance; returns a one-element array, `const [form] = Form.useForm<Values>()`. Pass
it to `<Form form={form}>`, then use it to read and set values, validate, submit or reset from outside the form,
such as from a button in the footer of a Modal. `V` is the type of the form values. Like any hook, call it at
the top level of a component.

types.name: FormInstance<V>
types.summary: The form instance returned by `Form.useForm()`: reads and writes values, validates, submits and resets.

fields.name: getFieldsValue
fields.description: All values of the form.

fields.name: getFieldValue
fields.description: Value of one field.

fields.name: setFieldsValue
fields.description: Sets the values of some fields; the others keep their values.

fields.name: setFieldValue
fields.description: Sets the value of one field.

fields.name: resetFields
fields.description: Resets the fields (all of them by default) to their initial values and clears the errors.

fields.name: validateFields
fields.description:
Validates the fields (all of them by default). Resolves to the values when they are valid; rejects with
`{ errorFields }` otherwise.

fields.name: submit
fields.description: Submits the form: validates, then calls `onFinish` or `onFinishFailed`.

fields.name: scrollToField
fields.description: Scrolls a field into view.

types.name: FormFinishFailedInfo<V>
types.summary: What `onFinishFailed` receives: the values and the fields that failed validation.

fields.name: values
fields.description: The values of the form.

fields.name: errorFields
fields.description: The fields that failed validation.

types.name: FieldName
types.summary: Name of a field: a string, or a path such as `['address', 'city']` for nested values.
types.definition: type FieldName = string | number | readonly (string | number)[]

types.name: FormRule
types.summary:
A validation rule of Form.Item. Several conditions in one rule must all hold; give `message` for the text shown
when the rule fails.

fields.name: required
fields.description: The field must have a value.

fields.name: whitespace
fields.description: With `required`, text consisting only of spaces counts as empty.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Kind of value: an `email` address, a `url`, a `number` or an `integer`.

fields.name: pattern
fields.description: The text must match this regular expression.

fields.name: min
fields.description: Smallest length of text or arrays, or smallest number.

fields.name: max
fields.description: Largest length of text or arrays, or largest number.

fields.name: len
fields.description: Exact length of text or arrays.

fields.name: validator
fields.description: Custom check: return (or resolve to) an error text when the value is invalid, nothing when it is valid.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Text shown when the rule fails. Without it, a default text in the language of the ThemeProvider is shown.

types.name: FormValues
types.summary: Values of a form: field name → value.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Path of the field.

fields.name: errors
fields.description: The error texts.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
Put fields in `Form.Item` and declare validation with `rules`; on submit, `onFinish` receives the values of all
fields.

examples.name: WithInstance
examples.title: Form instance
examples.description:
`Form.useForm()` returns an instance that validates and submits the form from outside, such as the confirm
button of a dialog.
